title: Airlines bankroll travel influencers — and normalise a high‑carbon lifestyle for Europeans
lede: Influencers can sell a glamorised lifestyle without it looking like an ad, and consumers are fooled. Though airlines get the win, the effects of over-tourism, climate deterioration, and basic legal transparency are increasingly difficult to ignore.
